title: Visual Sketchnote — An idea becomes a connected system

scenes.title: Spark
scenes.purpose: Write the heading and complete the lead icon (light bulb) with its numbered label.

Felt-pen light bulb outline, base, red filament and rays

beats.development: Heading 'An idea becomes' is written left to right; highlighter swipe begins.
'a connected system' finishes; the bulb outline draws, fills, gains base lines, red filament and rays; badge 1 and 'spark' are written beside it.

scenes.title: First links
scenes.purpose: One red connector carries the spark to the second fact.
visuals: Red curved arrow shaft, head appears only at shaft end

beats.development: Arrow shaft draws, then its head; triangle edges draw and node rings close in order; 'first links' is written.

scenes.title: A system
scenes.purpose: Second connector resolves into the hub-and-spoke system and the full reading path holds.
visuals: Red hub with four spokes, rim edges and nodes

beats.development: Arrow 2 draws then its head; red hub closes, spokes and rim draw, outer nodes close; 'a system!' is written.
Settled frame: complete left-to-right reading path 1 → 2 → 3 held for reading.
captions: An idea becomes a connected system
